title: DPOison-VL: Clean Preference Poisoning in Vision-Language Direct Preference Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.18609v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) has become a widely adopted approach for aligning vision-language models (VLMs), yet the security of multimodal preference data remains largely unexplored. Existing preference poisoning attacks either corrupt explicit supervision signals or require visible triggers, making them detectable under human inspection. We introduce DPOison-VL, the first clean preference poisoning attack against VLM-DPO, which manipulates model alignment solely through imperceptible perturbations on a small fraction of training images, while leaving all prompts, responses, and preference annotations semantically intact. We formulate poison construction as a bilevel optimization and derive a gradient alignment surrogate that efficiently steers image perturbations toward the attacker-specified preference. We further introduce a preference displacement score for principled poison selection with provable first-order optimality

translated_title: DPOison-VL：视觉语言直接偏好优化中的干净偏好投毒攻击
translated_abstract: 直接偏好优化（DPO）已成为对齐视觉语言模型（VLM）的广泛采用的方法，然而多模态偏好数据的安全性在很大程度上仍未被探索。现有的偏好投毒攻击要么破坏显式的监督信号，要么需要可见的触发器，这使得它们在人工检查下容易被发现。我们提出了DPOison-VL，这是首个针对VLM-DPO的干净偏好投毒攻击，它仅通过对训练图像中的一小部分施加不可察觉的扰动来操纵模型对齐，同时保持所有提示、响应和偏好标注在语义上完好无损。我们将毒样本构建形式化为双层优化问题，并推导出一个梯度对齐代理方法，能够高效地引导图像扰动朝向攻击者指定的偏好。我们进一步引入了偏好偏移分数，用于有原则的毒样本选择，并具有可证明的一阶最优性。
tldr: 提出了首个针对视觉语言模型DPO训练的干净偏好投毒攻击DPOison-VL，仅通过对少量训练图像施加不可察觉的扰动即可操纵模型对齐，同时保持所有文本和偏好标注语义完好，因而难以被人工检查发现。
en_tdlr: DPOison-VL is the first clean preference poisoning attack against VLM-DPO, which manipulates model alignment solely through imperceptible perturbations on a small fraction of training images while keeping all prompts, responses, and preference annotations semantically intact, making it hard to detect under human inspection.
